title: URL-encode filter operators in all PocketBase API calls
body: Encode complex filter operators: && → %26%26, || → %7C%7C, > → %3E. Unencoded operators silently break filters, returning unintended record sets. The bare & in 'filter=assigned_agent=misty&status=todo' ends the filter param early.
source_ref: rules.md:R18; lessons — 'URL Encoding for PocketBase Filter Operators'; 'Misty Phase 3 filter bug: 86+ duplicate task #68'
